what: Once the grid is fully laid, the panel fades in over .5s. Work photo cards are laid out in a grid one cell larger than the screen on each side, following the distance received from wheel (×.6) and drag (×1.2) by 5% per frame, wrapping cells to the panel size so they tile endlessly in every direction. Columns start offset vertically by .33 cell each, and vertical speeds of 1·1·.9 make the third column flow slightly late. Pushing horizontally also moves it vertically by 20% of that amount. The harder the push, the smaller the cards shrink, down to .5×, and when the hand stops (after 120ms) they return to full size by 2% per frame

options.min-scale: Smallest card scale while moving, default .5
options.x-to-y: Share of horizontal drift that spills into vertical, default .2
options.offset: Staggered start per column (share of cell height), default .33
options.intro: On first open the panel flies in from the bottom right by panel height × this value and settles, default 0 (none) — squared-media is 3

note: Dragging is this part’s job, so the wheel over the panel pushes the grid instead of the page (preventDefault) — if you keep the panel at screen height and put another section below, you have to scroll to that section from outside the panel. On touch devices it ignores dragging and passes vertical swipes to the page (touch-action: pan-y)
